segments.zh: 弄壞一個相依服務，看它拖垮整個頁面，再加上斷路器和健康檢查，把損害控制住。

segments.zh: 斷路器程式碼與 Kubernetes 探針範例

第 11 頁 · 階段 3 · 在故障中存活

segments.en: Circuit breakers, health checks, liveness and readiness probes
segments.zh: 斷路器、健康檢查、存活與就緒探針

segments.en: A broken recommendation box shouldn't break the whole page.
segments.zh: 一個壞掉的推薦區塊，不該弄壞整個頁面。

segments.en: EncoreThe concert page shows “Fans also bought…” from a recommendations service. That service hangs. Every page now waits for it to time out, Encore's servers run out of threads, and fans can't even see the concert. A box nobody needs took everything down.
segments.zh: Encore演唱會頁面會顯示來自推薦服務的「買了這場的人也買了……」。那個服務卡住了。現在每個頁面都在等它逾時，Encore 的伺服器用光了執行緒，歌迷連演唱會資訊都看不到。一個沒人需要的區塊，拖垮了一切。

segments.en: lab · break it, then fix it
segments.zh: 實驗室 · 先弄壞，再修好

segments.en: 20 page views a second, one flaky dependency
segments.zh: 每秒 20 次頁面瀏覽，一個不穩定的相依服務

segments.en: Each page view calls the recommendations service. When it works, the call takes 50 ms. When it's broken, the call hangs until a 2 s timeout. Encore's server has 30 threads, and each call holds one. Simulated numbers.
segments.zh: 每次頁面瀏覽都會呼叫推薦服務。正常時呼叫花 50 毫秒；壞掉時呼叫會一直卡到 2 秒逾時。Encore 的伺服器有 30 條執行緒，每次呼叫佔一條。數字是模擬的。

segments.en: Press Play to start the traffic.

Without a breaker, every request keeps calling a dependency that's known to be broken, and waits the full timeout each time. A circuit breaker counts failures. After a few in a row it opens: calls are skipped instantly and a fallback is used. After a cooldown it lets one test call through, and closes again if that works.
segments.zh: 沒有斷路器時，每個請求都會持續呼叫一個明知壞掉的相依服務，而且每次都等滿逾時。斷路器會計算失敗次數；連續失敗幾次後它就開啟：呼叫立刻被跳過，改用備援方案（fallback）。冷卻一段時間後，它會放一次測試呼叫通過，成功的話就再度關閉。
第 2 幕 · 健康檢查

segments.en: Three instances, two kinds of “are you OK?”
segments.zh: 三個執行個體，兩種「你還好嗎？」

segments.en: The load balancer sends traffic to three copies of Encore's API. api-2 just started and is still loading its cache. api-3 is stuck in a deadlock: the process is running, but it never answers. Pick which checks the platform runs, then move time forward.
segments.zh: 負載平衡器把流量送到 Encore API 的三份副本。api-2 剛啟動，還在載入快取。api-3 卡在死結裡：行程還在跑，卻永遠不回應。選擇平台要執行哪些檢查，然後讓時間往前走。

segments.en: “Is this process stuck?” If it fails several times, restart it. That fixes deadlocks and hangs.
segments.zh: 「這個行程卡住了嗎？」連續失敗幾次就重新啟動它。這能修好死結和卡死。

segments.en: “Can it take traffic right now?” If not, stop sending it requests, but don't restart it. For startup, warm-up, or a lost database connection.
segments.zh: 「它現在能接流量嗎？」不能的話就停止送請求給它，但不要重新啟動。用於啟動中、暖機中，或資料庫連線中斷時。
第 3 幕 · 真實世界

segments.en: A breaker in a few lines, probes in a few more
segments.zh: 幾行就是一個斷路器，再幾行就是探針

segments.en: , a common Node.js library. The probes are Kubernetes settings. Hover or tap a line.
segments.zh: ，一個常見的 Node.js 函式庫。探針則是 Kubernetes 的設定。把滑鼠移到某一行上，或點一下。

segments.en: Each highlighted line maps to the lab.
segments.zh: 每一行反白後，都會對應到實驗室。
重點整理 · 帶走這些

segments.en: The whole page on one screen
After repeated failures, skip the call and use a fallback. Test now and then, and resume when it works.
segments.zh: 連續失敗後，跳過呼叫並改用備援方案。偶爾測試一下，恢復正常時再繼續呼叫。

segments.en: Detects a process that's stuck, and restarts it. Keep it simple: don't fail it because a dependency is down.
segments.zh: 偵測卡住的行程並重新啟動它。保持簡單：不要因為相依服務掛了就讓它失敗。

segments.en: Detects an instance that can't serve yet, and takes it out of the load balancer until it can.
segments.zh: 偵測還不能服務的執行個體，把它從負載平衡器中移除，直到它準備好。

segments.en: A breaker turns a slow failure into a fast, partial one: fans get the page without recommendations. That only works if you design a fallback. Thresholds that are too sensitive open on small blips; too lax, and they open after the damage is done.
segments.zh: 斷路器把緩慢的失敗變成快速的、局部的失敗：歌迷看到的是沒有推薦內容的頁面。前提是你設計了備援方案。門檻太敏感，小小波動就會開啟；太寬鬆，等它開啟時傷害已經造成了。

segments.en: 'Press Play with the service healthy and no breaker.'
segments.zh: '在服務健康、沒有斷路器的情況下按播放。'

segments.en: 'Calls take 50 ms. Only one thread is busy at a time.'
segments.zh: '呼叫只要 50 毫秒。同一時間只有一條執行緒在忙。'

segments.en: 'Every page now waits 2 s for the timeout. Threads fill up, and soon pages fail entirely.'
segments.zh: '現在每個頁面都要等 2 秒逾時。執行緒被佔滿，很快頁面就完全失敗了。'

segments.en: 'After 5 failures in a row it opens. Pages load in 80 ms again, just without recommendations.'
segments.zh: '連續失敗 5 次後它就開啟。頁面又能在 80 毫秒內載入，只是沒有推薦內容。'

segments.en: 'Set the service back to Healthy and wait.'
segments.zh: '把服務設回健康，然後等一下。'

segments.en: 'After a 5 s cooldown the breaker goes half-open, sends one test call, sees it work, and closes.'
segments.zh: '冷卻 5 秒後，斷路器進入半開狀態，送出一次測試呼叫，看到成功就關閉。'
'頁面在沒有推薦內容時也能運作'

segments.en: `✕ All ${THREADS} threads are stuck waiting on the broken service, so ${Math.round(m.err * 100)}% of page views fail completely, even though the concert info itself is fine.`
segments.zh: `✕ ${THREADS} 條執行緒全都卡在等那個壞掉的服務，所以 ${Math.round(m.err * 100)}% 的頁面瀏覽完全失敗，即使演唱會資訊本身一點問題都沒有。`

segments.en: '⚠ Every page waits the full 2 s timeout for recommendations that never come.'
segments.zh: '⚠ 每個頁面都要等滿 2 秒逾時，等一份永遠不會來的推薦內容。'

segments.en: `✓ Breaker open: the call is skipped, and pages load in ${BASE} ms without recommendations. Next test call in ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil((S.openUntil - S.t) / 1000))} s.`
segments.zh: `✓ 斷路器開啟：呼叫被跳過，頁面在 ${BASE} 毫秒內載入，只是沒有推薦內容。${Math.max(0, Math.ceil((S.openUntil - S.t) / 1000))} 秒後進行下一次測試呼叫。`

segments.en: '⏸ Half-open: one test call is going through. Everyone else still gets the fallback.'
segments.zh: '⏸ 半開：一次測試呼叫正在進行。其他人仍然拿到備援方案。'

segments.en: '✓ Healthy: pages load quickly, with recommendations.'
segments.zh: '✓ 健康：頁面載入很快，而且有推薦內容。'

segments.en:
`
${p.n}${pill}
${p.proc === 'restarted' ? '↻ restarted by liveness' : p.proc}${p.note ? ' · ' + p.note : ''}
${gets(p) ? (p.ready ? '✓ gets traffic' : '✕ gets traffic, fails it') : '– no traffic (not ready)'}
`
segments.zh:
`
${p.n}${pill}
${p.proc === 'restarted' ? '↻ 已由存活探針重新啟動' : p.proc === 'deadlocked' ? '死結' : '執行中'}${p.note ? ' · ' + p.note : ''}
${gets(p) ? (p.ready ? '✓ 有接到流量' : '✕ 有接到流量，但處理失敗') : '– 沒有流量（尚未就緒）'}
`

segments.en: `✕ ${pct}% of requests go to an instance that can't answer. ${mode === 0 ? 'With no checks, nobody notices api-3 is stuck, ever.' : mode === 1 ? 'Liveness restarted api-3, but instances still get traffic while they\'re warming up.' : ''}`
segments.zh: `✕ ${pct}% 的請求被送到無法回應的執行個體。${mode === 0 ? '沒有任何檢查，永遠沒人發現 api-3 卡住了。' : mode === 1 ? '存活探針重新啟動了 api-3，但執行個體在暖機時仍然會接到流量。' : ''}`

segments.en: `✓ Every request lands on an instance that's ready. ${mode === 2 && step < 3 ? 'Warming instances are skipped until their readiness probe passes.' : ''}`
segments.zh: `✓ 每個請求都落在已就緒的執行個體上。${mode === 2 && step < 3 ? '暖機中的執行個體會被跳過，直到它的就緒探針通過。' : ''}`

segments.en: 'breaker.fallback(() => []); // render the page without recommendations'
segments.zh: 'breaker.fallback(() => []); // 在沒有推薦內容的情況下呈現頁面'

segments.en: 'The breaker sits between your code and the dependency, and counts how calls go.'
segments.zh: '斷路器位於你的程式碼和相依服務之間，記錄每次呼叫的結果。'

segments.en: 'A call that takes longer than 2 s counts as a failure. You still need timeouts; the breaker builds on them.'
segments.zh: '超過 2 秒的呼叫就算失敗。你仍然需要逾時；斷路器是建立在逾時之上的。'

segments.en: 'opossum opens when half of the recent calls fail, measured over a rolling window. The lab uses a simpler rule: 5 failures in a row.'
segments.zh: 'opossum 會在最近的呼叫有一半失敗時開啟，以滾動時間窗計算。實驗室用的是更簡單的規則：連續失敗 5 次。'

segments.en: 'How long to stay open before trying a test call (half-open). The lab uses 5 s.'
segments.zh: '開啟後要等多久才嘗試測試呼叫（半開）。實驗室用的是 5 秒。'

segments.en: 'What to return while open. Here, an empty list, so the page renders without the box. Without a fallback, a breaker just fails faster.'
segments.zh: '開啟時要回傳什麼。這裡是空的清單，所以頁面會在沒有那個區塊的情況下呈現。沒有備援方案，斷路器只是讓失敗來得更快。'

segments.en: 'Closed: calls the service. Open: returns the fallback instantly, without touching the network.'
segments.zh: '關閉時：呼叫服務。開啟時：立刻回傳備援方案，完全不碰網路。'

segments.en: 'Kubernetes calls /healthz every 10 s. After 3 failures it restarts the container. That\'s what fixed the stuck api-3. Keep this endpoint dumb: “the process can answer”.'
segments.zh: 'Kubernetes 每 10 秒呼叫一次 /healthz，失敗 3 次就重新啟動容器。這就是修好卡住的 api-3 的東西。讓這個端點保持單純：「行程能回應」就好。'

segments.en: 'While /ready fails, the instance is removed from the load balancer, but not restarted. That\'s what kept traffic away from warming instances.'
segments.zh: '/ready 失敗期間，執行個體會被移出負載平衡器，但不會被重新啟動。這就是讓流量遠離暖機中執行個體的東西。'

segments.en: 'The reviews service is down. With a 3 s timeout, every concert page takes 3 s and some fail. What helps most?'
segments.zh: '評論服務掛了。逾時設 3 秒，每個演唱會頁面都要 3 秒，有些還會失敗。什麼最有幫助？'

segments.en: 'Raise the timeout to 30 s so calls have time to finish'
segments.zh: '把逾時提高到 30 秒，讓呼叫有時間完成'

segments.en: 'The service is down. A longer timeout just makes every page wait longer and holds threads longer.'
segments.zh: '服務掛了。更長的逾時只會讓每個頁面等更久、佔住執行緒更久。'

segments.en: 'A circuit breaker with a fallback that renders the page without reviews'
segments.zh: '加上斷路器，並提供在沒有評論時呈現頁面的備援方案'

segments.en: 'After a few failures, skip the call entirely and show the page without that section. Fast and still useful.'
segments.zh: '失敗幾次後就完全跳過呼叫，顯示沒有那個區塊的頁面。又快又仍然有用。'
'每次失敗的呼叫重試 3 次'

segments.en: 'Retrying a service that\'s down multiplies the load and the waiting (see page 9).'
segments.zh: '重試一個掛掉的服務，只會讓負載和等待加倍（見第 9 頁）。'

segments.en: 'Dee makes the liveness probe check the database too. The database has a 1-minute blip. What happens?'
segments.zh: 'Dee 讓存活探針也檢查資料庫。資料庫出了 1 分鐘的小狀況。會發生什麼事？'

segments.en: 'Nothing: the probe just reports the blip'
segments.zh: '沒事：探針只是回報這個狀況'
'存活探針失敗會觸發重新啟動。'

segments.en: 'Every instance fails liveness and gets restarted at once, so the blip becomes a full outage'
segments.zh: '每個執行個體的存活探針都失敗，同時被重新啟動，小狀況變成全面停擺'

segments.en: 'Liveness should only ask “is this process stuck?”. Put dependency checks in readiness, or nowhere.'
segments.zh: '存活探針只該問「這個行程卡住了嗎？」。相依服務的檢查放在就緒探針，或乾脆不放。'

segments.en: 'Only the instances that talk to the database restart'
segments.zh: '只有會連到資料庫的執行個體會重新啟動'

segments.en: 'All of them talk to it, so they all fail the probe together.'
segments.zh: '它們全都會連到資料庫，所以會一起讓探針失敗。'

segments.en: 'A new instance needs 40 s to load its cache before it can answer quickly. Which check keeps fans from hitting it too early?'
segments.zh: '新的執行個體需要 40 秒載入快取，才能快速回應。哪一種檢查能避免歌迷太早打到它？'

segments.en: 'Liveness would restart it for being slow, possibly forever.'
segments.zh: '存活探針會因為它太慢而重新啟動它，可能永無止境。'

segments.en: 'It stays out of the load balancer until it reports ready. No restarts, no errors.'
segments.zh: '它會一直待在負載平衡器之外，直到回報就緒。不會重新啟動，也不會出錯。'

segments.en: 'Breakers protect callers from a dependency. Getting traffic to the right instance is the platform\'s job.'
segments.zh: '斷路器是用來保護呼叫端免受相依服務影響的。把流量送到對的執行個體，是平台的工作。'
